quarterly_data.signal: Preliminary (pre-audit) non-consolidated figures for Q2 of the fiscal year ending March 2027 (July-September 2026): shipment value JPY 1,239 hundred million, up 60.0% year on year and 6.4% quarter on quarter - the company's highest quarterly shipment value, as shipments of both precision processing equipment and precision processing tools stayed at high levels, centred on generative-AI applications. Non-consolidated net sales JPY 1,185 hundred million, up 38.9% YoY and 24.7% QoQ. First half: net sales JPY 2,136 hundred million, up 32.8%, 106.2% of the latest non-consolidated forecast (net sales JPY 2,011 hundred million); shipment value JPY 2,405 hundred million, up 41.1% (Q1 JPY 1,165 hundred million, up 25.3%). The company books equipment sales at customer acceptance, so it discloses shipment value as the figure more closely linked to the market.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 shipments JPY 1,239 hundred million, +60.0% YoY, record quarter; Q2 net sales JPY 1,185 hundred million, +38.9% YoY
